topic_title: Wrong accusative case suffix on the word "Exercism"
excerpt: Yes, each of those should have a hyphen. According to A magyar helyesírás szabályai when a suffix is added to a word that keeps its foreign/original spelling and the pronunciation of the word’s ending doesn’t match how it’s written, a hyphen is inserted before the suffix (e.g., “Exercism-öt,” “Chicago-ban,” “New York-i”). If the spelling already matches the pronunciation, no hyphen is needed. Exer
resolved_note: Applied dem4ron hyphen rule to all Exercism case suffixes in hu (744 occurrences), guide and notes updated, pushed. Replied (post 193315) with the derived suffix forms and two follow-up questions (Exercism-es or -ös, lowercase exercism CLI).

topic_title: Grammatical issues with published/közzétett on "New on Exercism"
excerpt: The Hungarian translation of “published” (közzétett) assumes a singular subject inside a track’s “New on Exercism” feed, creating grammatical issues. If there are no authors or contributors listed, the English website uses “We published” which is then translated to We közzétett. közzétett is the third-person singular past tense, but this needs the second-person plural past tense which is közzétett
resolved_note: Website builds the We and N others parts in English in Ruby, so translation cannot fix the reported cases. Guide and notes updated. Replied (post 193646). Website change to bring to iHiD.

topic_title: Grammatical issues with published/közzétett on "New on Exercism"
excerpt: In Hungarian, there should be no comma before “és” when you’re listing out items. “és” replaces the final comma. “juhlig, iHiD és 3-an közzétettek” is correct as you noted. If “és” is connecting two independent clauses, a comma should be used in front of it like “Jöttünk, és mentünk.” (we came, and we went). That isn’t specific to “és” because Hungarian places a comma at clause boundaries so I cou
resolved_note: BNAndras confirmed the no-comma-before-es rule and juhlig, iHiD es 3-an kozzetettek; added the clause-boundary comma rule. Nothing to change, no reply needed.
